signal: Swoogo launched a native MCP server, the first event platform connecting live event data to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT.

email.body1:
Riley, saw Swoogo just shipped the first native MCP server for an event platform, pushing live event data straight into AI tools.

A launch like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the buzz fades, and that is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Swoogo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Riley, quick follow-up for Swoogo.

Riding the MCP momentum, the gap is usually that nobody knows exactly how many meetings the team must book to hit the number this quarter. The math shows up late, and by then you are scrambling to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Swoogo needs to close that gap, and where it breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Riley, last bit of proof for Swoogo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Swoogo's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Riley, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Coming off a product launch, I know attention is split a hundred ways and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Swoogo either way.
